info.text:
Squirrel lends 100 acorns and wants 105 back. Why?
Interest is rent: the price of using someone else's money for a while. It pays for waiting, inflation and risk.
In Oct 2026 the average savings rate was 0.38% (FDIC). In Aug 2026 card balances were charged 22.36% (Fed G.19).
The 30-year mortgage averaged 2.96% in 2021 and 6.6% in 2025 (Freddie Mac). The Fed's target range was 3.75%-4% as of Oct 2026.
Sources: Federal Reserve, FDIC, Freddie Mac via FRED.
News and education, not financial advice.
